description: This PHP script is a unit test for outbound email functionality in the SuiteCRM project, specifically for testing email sending capabilities via the Email module. It sets configuration parameters, retrieves user email account data, and performs email test sending, outputting the result in JSON format.

classes.name: Email
classes.description: Represents email functionalities within the SuiteCRM framework, used here to send test emails.

classes.name: OutboundEmail
classes.description: Handles the retrieval of SMTP settings for outbound email configuration.

methods.name: sendEmailTest
methods.description: Sends a test email using specified SMTP server settings, returns the success or failure status.
